deviceNotifications.title: Notifications on this device
deviceNotifications.lead: This browser can let you know when something is waiting for you in DIASPORA.GA, even with the tab closed. The alert never says who or what: it opens DIASPORA.GA, where you read it.
deviceNotifications.consent: Turning this on counts as your "Notifications" consent for DIASPORA.GA. You can withdraw it under "Consents": nothing is sent any more, to any device.

state.unsupported: This browser does not receive notifications. On iPhone, first add DIASPORA.GA to your home screen.
state.unavailable: Device notifications are unavailable for now.
state.denied: Notifications from this site are blocked in your browser. Allow them in its settings, then come back here.
state.off: This device does not receive DIASPORA.GA notifications.

deviceNotifications.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
deviceNotifications.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.

errors.push_unavailable: Device notifications are unavailable for now.
errors.push_denied: You declined notifications in your browser. Allow them in its settings to turn them on.
errors.push_cancelled: Turning notifications on did not complete. Try again and accept the browser's request.
errors.push_unsupported: This browser does not receive notifications.
